summary: CDT Environmental Technology Investment Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing its press release announcing the filing of its 2025 annual report on Form 20-F with the SEC. The filing includes financial results such as total revenues of $18.2 million (down 38.8% YoY) and a net loss of $10.3 million. The press release discusses operational updates, restructuring, and backlog. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or management change is disclosed; this is a routine annual report filing.
